claim_ceiling: The TF-IDF production family (8 representations) has been exhaustively evaluated at 174k scale under frozen protocol v25. No representation passes all 12 benchmarks. A fundamental citation vs full-text tradeoff exists. Hierarchy coherence (max 0.465 purity) and legal area clustering (max 0.011 purity) hit label granularity limits, not representation limits. The HNSW backend introduces a methodological artifact (identical k-NN graphs across representations) that invalidates jurist pairwise at 174k; exact k-NN shows healthy jurist pairwise (~0.73-0.80) but complete cross-language retrieval failure (~0.01). Dense embeddings at 1200 scale show promise (5/7 pass adversarial gates) but universally fail boilerplate resistance. The 174k evaluation of 11 awaited dense representations is blocked on legal-distance pipeline delivery (52% computed, corpus artifact publication gap). The HNSW artifact MUST BE FIXED (exact k-NN for adversarial benchmarks) before dense 174k evaluation proceeds.
evidence_summary: Verified: v25 formal suite results (8 reps × 12 benchmarks, config hash 4323f833fa72366a), citation heritage AUCs (137,314 frozen pairs), v17b normalization gains (45-64% for 5/8 reps, 0 worsen), full-corpus adversarial at 174k (exact k-NN, 8 TF-IDF reps, jurist pairwise 0.73-0.80), dense 1200 baselines (7 reps, exact k-NN, 5/7 pass both gates). HNSW artifact CONFIRMED: v3 harness (HNSW) shows jurist pairwise=0.122 for all 8 reps; exact k-NN on valid 1199 shows 0.73-0.80. 6/8 reps have identical HNSW k-NN graphs. Dense 174k progress: 14/27 years (52%) in checkpoints; blocked on corpus artifact publication gap. All artifacts traceable to frozen protocol, frozen metadata (173,963 decisions), pinned parquet. No tuning, leakage, or benchmark gaming detected. Negative/null results honestly represented. Repair round 1 only adds verification state/logs — no experimental changes.
